root_cause: After heartbeat transport was moved to IPv4 Supavisor, the winning external heartbeat transaction still synchronously rebuilt the full 180-day revenue attribution snapshot. That materialization repeatedly hit statement and lock timeouts, so overlap retries returned 202 while no durable VERIFIED commercial heartbeat could complete.
prevention: Keep attribution materialization under the existing powerhouse-runtime-scheduler-mux-v1 maintenance owner at minutes 7/22/37/52. The five-minute heartbeat reads the durable attribution snapshot and the canonical revenue-event-spine health projection only; attribution balance, gaps and freshness remain visible evidence, but whole-history refresh is no longer in the latency-critical transaction.
